mechanics_text: Can only be mined at Naneroh in the Ginoya System — requires Gamma Shield II.
One of only two cores (with Void Essence) that cannot be found at any Hangar unless placed there.
Mining before end of Supernova storyline is nearly impossible; Gamma Shield II depletes first — use Rhoda Vortex to buy extra time.
30t (100t in extreme mode) Novanium ore can be exchanged for 1 core at the Mido Mining Plant in Coromesk (Skavac system).
